name: Pair of Qingbai Ware Bowls with Covers
material: Porcelain with pale bluish-white (qingbai; 青白) glaze; silver mount
summary: While dark-glazed ceramics resemble black lacquer ware, and celadons were often compared to green jade, white or bluish-white glazed stoneware imitates silver.
